title: Onboard helix-13b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Onboard helix-13b-v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, performance profiles, and automatic changelog/release note generation. Motivation: Helix has shown competitive latency/cost tradeoffs for our mid-range generation workloads and is requested by several pilot customers. This PR adds model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, recommended quantizations), a set of perf profiles generated from benchmark-lab runs, and wiring for changelog automation so that new model entries populate the release notes feed automatically. Checklist: 1) Add model metadata JSON and manifest. 2) Add perf profiles for common sequence lengths and batch sizes. 3) Add release notes entry templates and automation hooks. 4) Add docs snippet to model registry README referencing recommended configs. 5) Run CI and perf validation. Implementation notes: metadata files are under models/helix-13b/v1.0/metadata.json and models/helix-13b/v1.0/manifest.yaml. Perf profiles are generated into models/helix-13b/v1.0/perf-profiles/ with cpu/gpu entries and summary CSV. Changelog automation: registry-changelog-bot now picks up new manifest files and creates draft release notes via the existing pipeline. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan. Backwards compatibility: existing registry consumers will ignore new optional fields. This PR includes test coverage for manifest parsing and a sanity perf check harness invocation.

release_notes: - Onboard helix-13b v1.0: new model available in the registry with recommended metadata and perf profiles. - Added changelog automation so future model onboards automatically create draft release notes.
notes_for_ops: No runtime changes. Ops should ensure the perf-profiles storage path is included in backup policy and that changelog-bot service account has read access to models/*/manifest.yaml.
testing_summary: Unit tests for manifest parsing added and passing. Perf validation run against internal perf-canary cluster with representative sequences (64/256/1024) and batch sizes (1,4,8). Summary CSV attached in perf-profiles folder. No regressions detected compared to baseline models in the same class.
risk_and_mitigation: Low risk. Model entry is additive and optional. Automation has a dry-run mode and creates draft notes only; rollout will start with internal-only visibility. If automation misfires, we can disable the registry-hook via feature flag.
how_to_verify: 1) Inspect models/helix-13b/v1.0/manifest.yaml for required fields. 2) Run scripts/generate_perf_profiles/README.md command to reproduce profiles. 3) Validate registry-changelog-bot created a draft release note in the drafts queue.
associated_linear_tickets: PM-441: Product validation for Helix pilots
user_impact: Developers can now select helix-13b-v1.0 from the model catalog. No immediate customer-facing behavior changes beyond availability.
